subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep audit cap installed plugin package manifests at 1 MiB and continue with directory-only scanning when a manifest exceeds that limit?
rationale: The cap removes an unbounded untrusted-file read, but oversized manifests can no longer provide declared extension entrypoints for paths intentionally skipped by ordinary traversal.

options.title: Accept bounded fallback
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, visible warning, and directory-only fallback for oversized manifests.

options.title: Preserve declared entries
options.body: Pause merge and require a different bounded extraction design that retains declared-entrypoint coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, visible warning, and directory-only fallback for oversized manifests.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently hardened the exact malformed-manifest and scan-coverage behavior whose boundary this PR changes.
